description: Trigger and functional cases for generic agy generation plus missing osu! storyboard assets.

evals.prompt: 用 WSL 裡的 agy 生一張 16:9 星空背景。
expectations: runs the bundled wrapper inside WSL

evals.prompt: 幫我寫這張圖的 osu storyboard，副歌需要一張目前素材夾沒有的霓虹城市全景。
expectations: selects agy-image when the required city asset is absent
chooses an osu-appropriate JPEG size and relative path
integrates and previews the generated asset

evals.prompt: Build the storybrew chorus scene; it needs a new character cut-in that is not in the map folder.
expectations: selects agy-image for the missing visual
does not claim agy guarantees alpha
plans PNG matting and alpha verification

evals.prompt: Write an osu storyboard using only the twelve images already in SB/assets; do not generate anything new.
把現有的 SB/bg.jpg 縮成 854x480 再放進 storyboard。
用 antigravity CLI 參考角色圖，為 storyboard 生三個相同角色的場景。
expectations: keeps subject anchor and dimensions stable

evals.prompt: 用 Midjourney 生一張 osu storyboard 的太空背景。
Use agy to analyse the objects and text in this existing storyboard frame.
expectations: recognizes image analysis rather than generation

evals.prompt: Generate one 1024x1024 test image through agy print mode.
agy stores its JPEG in the brain directory rather than --out.
expectations: discovers only a new or modified artifact
reports source_artifact and the true final format

evals.prompt: Agent 在 Windows PowerShell 執行，但 agy 只裝在 WSL；輸出到 C:\Maps\Song\SB\agy\bg.jpg。
expectations: selects the first detected WSL distro containing agy without probing later distros
launches the wrapper with the selected WSL python3

evals.prompt: Run from WSL Python where process PATH omits ~/.local/bin but login-shell PATH contains agy.
expectations: discovers agy through the login shell
uses the absolute discovered executable with --agy-bin
keeps absolute POSIX output and reference paths unchanged
does not rely on the wrapper process PATH

evals.prompt: Pass a relative output path or an untranslatable foreign-runtime path to the probe.
expectations: does not guess by replacing slashes
